label: FreeSurfer mri_normalize
description:
Intensity normalization using FreeSurfer mri_normalize.

The interface exposes the typed options listed below; the original installed-version help is retained in source references.

parameters.label: no1d
parameters.description: Disable initial one-dimensional intensity normalization; use when its assumptions do not fit the image.
parameters.usage: Disable initial one-dimensional intensity normalization; use when its assumptions do not fit the image. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: noconform
parameters.description: Keep the original voxel grid instead of conforming to 256 cubed.
parameters.usage: Keep the original voxel grid instead of conforming to 256 cubed. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: n
parameters.usage: Number of three-dimensional normalization iterations. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: a
parameters.description: Maximum control-point intensity above the white-matter target.
parameters.usage: Maximum control-point intensity above the white-matter target. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

parameters.label: b
parameters.description: Maximum control-point intensity below the white-matter target.
parameters.usage: Maximum control-point intensity below the white-matter target. Unset optional values are not passed to the command.
parameters.software_default: The installed command decides omitted values; see the pinned help snapshot.

input_slots.label: mask
input_slots.description: Optional brain mask in the input image grid.

input_slots.label: input
input_slots.description: Input image. Choose an existing file; the command never modifies it.

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: Native command output, saved in this run’s output directory. Intensity normalization using FreeSurfer mri_normalize. The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.

omitted_options.other_options: Only the documented options below are exposed. Consult the installed-version help for other syntax; arbitrary arguments are not accepted.
